summary_md: **eigen ([@e1genqq](https://x.com/e1genqq/status/2116740739929379038))** lists a free open-source motion studio of 22 repos he pairs with a frontier model instead of After Effects, including Remotion, Anime.js, Theatre.js, Three.js, Spark Gaussian splats, Taichi, SPlisHSPlasH, OpenToonz, Qwen3-TTS, auto-editor, RIFE, OBS and FFmpeg ([remotion-dev/remotion](https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion), [sparkjsdev/spark](https://github.com/sparkjsdev/spark), [QwenLM/Qwen3-TTS](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-TTS)).
